object.name: InputMediaPhoto
object.description: Represents a photo to be sent.
object.rst_description: Represents a photo to be sent.

annotations.name: type
annotations.description: Type of the media, must be photo
annotations.rst_description: Type of the media, must be *photo*

annotations.name: media
annotations.description: File to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended), pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass 'attach://' to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under  name. More information on Sending Files »
annotations.html_description: File to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended), pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass “attach://” to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under name. More information on Sending Files »
annotations.rst_description: File to send. Pass a file_id to send a file that exists on the Telegram servers (recommended), pass an HTTP URL for Telegram to get a file from the Internet, or pass 'attach://' to upload a new one using multipart/form-data under  name. :ref:`More information on Sending Files » <sending-files>`

annotations.name: caption
annotations.description: Optional. Caption of the photo to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
annotations.html_description: Optional. Caption of the photo to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Caption of the photo to be sent, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing

annotations.name: parse_mode
annotations.description: Optional. Mode for parsing entities in the photo caption. See formatting options for more details.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Mode for parsing entities in the photo caption. See formatting options for more details.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Mode for parsing entities in the photo caption. See `formatting options <https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options>`_ for more details.

annotations.name: caption_entities
annotations.description: Optional. List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode
annotations.html_description: Optional. List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of parse_mode
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. List of special entities that appear in the caption, which can be specified instead of *parse_mode*

annotations.name: show_caption_above_media
annotations.description: Optional. Pass True if the caption must be shown above the message media
annotations.html_description: Optional. Pass True if the caption must be shown above the message media
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Pass :code:`True` if the caption must be shown above the message media

annotations.name: has_spoiler
annotations.description: Optional. Pass True if the photo needs to be covered with a spoiler animation
annotations.html_description: Optional. Pass True if the photo needs to be covered with a spoiler animation
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Pass :code:`True` if the photo needs to be covered with a spoiler animation
